content.introduction: On November 3, 2026, the main stock market index of the United States, the US Index 500, had different closing values according to the sources. According to one source, it rose to 7556 points, gaining 0.20% from the previous session. Another source reported it fell to 7533 points, losing 0.12% from the previous session. The sources also provide differing month-over-month declines: one reports a 2.80% decline, while another reports a 3.10% decline. Despite these discrepancies, all sources agree that the index remains significantly higher than a year ago, ranging from 11.13% to 11.59% higher.

Historically, the United States Stock Market Index reached an all time high of 7844.67 in October of 2026.
